body:
maria gonzalez: Quick sync — putting together a 2-week 'marketplace SI skill grooming' for partners doing cloud marketplace + HW integrations. Need training owners, acceptance criteria, and a lightweight cert path.
kevin o'neill: Love it. Can we include a checklist for marketplace listing readiness (billing config, logos, screenshots, security checklist, legal contact)? :thumbsup:
sachin patel: Also propose SI engineer badges: Foundation (docs + eval), Integrator (hands-on lab), Partner-Pro (joint customer run). Keep each gate <= 2 hours of eval.
jade wu: Can we pilot with EdgeWave SI — they already have marketplace images and a small rack we can use for live validation. cc @kevin
partner-ops-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.link/si-grooming-draft (permissions: partnerships, solutions-eng).
maria gonzalez: Draft agenda I posted in doc:
- Week 1: Marketplace publishing + compliance runthrough + mock listing review
- Week 2: Hardware validation day (rack bringup, network, KV-cache perf sanity) + runbook handoff
I want a 90m live session each week + 2h lab window for partner engineers.
kevin o'neill: Scheduling note — Tue/Thu 09:30 PT / 17:30 CET worked last quarter. Also recommend an automated lab harness so partners can self-run hardware smoke tests:
```bash
# run from partner VM
./scripts/si_lab_runner.sh --rack 1 --profile smoke --model gpt-3.5-redwood
```
sachin patel: For the cert gates, we should codify pass/fail as checklist items in the LMS + a short recording requirement for integrator level. Keeps grading deterministic.
jade wu: I'll coordinate with EdgeWave and confirm rack availability for Apr 14-15.
maria gonzalez: Owners: Partnerships = Maria (program), Solutions Eng = Kevin (content + labs), Eng Runtime = Sachin (validation criteria). I'll pull a calendar invite when dates are confirmed.
kevin o'neill: I'll draft the mock listing template and a minimal security checklist by EOD Friday.
sachin patel: I'll write the perf smoke tests and add them to the repo under `integrations/si/validation`.
jade wu: EdgeWave confirmed pilot slot Apr 14. Moving to calendar now. :rocket:
maria gonzalez: Great — next steps: Kevin + Sachin to attach artifacts to the doc, Jade confirms pilot participants, I'll create the LMS course stub. Ping me in thread with blockers.
kevin o'neill: sgtm, pinged.
sachin patel: no blockers from infra side.
partner-ops-bot: Reminder set for Apr 7 to finalize materials.
maria gonzalez: Thanks everyone :heart:
